For U=1 it also scans alacritty's cells for U+10EEEE placeholders. host.rs: TeeReader::read feeds a per-pane libghostty Terminal on the reader thread before alacritty parses (thread-local, because the handle is !Send). It enables the file, temp and shm media, installs a PNG decoder, and filters write_pty down to Kitty APC replies. To stop the divergence it must also rewrite the stream: find each direct placement without C=1, inject the equivalent cursor motion into alacritty's input at that byte offset, and forward the rewritten bytes to clients so the replica still hashes equal. That means TD frames Kitty APC itself anyway, which is the approach Zellij takes in front of the same vte 0.15. gridwire.rs: encode_snapshot and grid_hash cover text only. The attach protocol needs a picture message (image bytes plus placements), because the replica window cannot re-read temp or shm transmissions the host already consumed. Build: Zig 0.15.2 or 0.16 plus git/network, or a vendored ghostty source, in the AppImage and AUR builds.

zmx.label: zmx — server-side snapshots with libghostty-vt (host/replica prior art)

bus_factor.source: code: the first count in the agents' value

licence.value: MIT — an MIT product may copy or adapt its code with the notice kept; its libghostty-vt dependency is MIT too.

facts.risk: Taking zmx as the model for TD's re-attach would carry text only: its snapshot drops every Kitty, Sixel and iTerm2 picture (the formatter has no image output and the issue asking for it has been open since December 2025), so a re-attached TD window would still need its own picture replay path.
facts.migration: Nothing to adopt as code (zmx is an application); five design points TD's host/replica could borrow, mostly in host.rs and gridwire.rs: (1) resize the host grid to the attaching window's size BEFORE snapshotting, then resize the PTY and SIGWINCH the foreground process group even when the size is unchanged, so TUIs repaint after the snapshot (loop.zig L967-1016); (2) strip DECSET 2026 from the snapshot so a replica does not sit deferring renders; (3) replay title (OSC 2), cwd (OSC 7), dynamic colours and the scroll region, which gridwire.rs does not carry today; (4) answer DA only while no window is attached and otherwise let exactly one leader's replies through — TD already writes replies once from the host, so this is a check, not a change; (5) feed and broadcast on one thread so the snapshot/stream seam cannot exist — TD instead fences alacritty's reader thread with a lease in host.rs. Points NOT to copy: zmx's snapshot has the same alt-screen gap as gridwire, emits modes before content (TD's modes-last order is deliberately safer), drops OSC 8 links and all pictures, and has no equivalent of grid_hash / ReplicaGuard. If TD ever moves its host to libghostty-vt, zmx shows that the formatter can replace gridwire::encode_snapshot for text, and ghostty's binary snapshot (ghostty_snapshot_*) is the better candidate for a libghostty-vt replica; pane.rs, term.rs, socketpty.rs, main.rs and pane/bench.rs are untouched by anything zmx teaches.
